title: Most of the world's great megaliths have never been dated directly
dek: First results from Stratum: what 26 checked cases and three data studies show — and the tests that could rewrite the dates, or confirm them.

points.head: 35 of 40 famous megaliths are dated only by association.
points.text: Only one — Nan Madol — has a direct date on its building stones; three have no date at all. The ages of the Great Sphinx, Carnac, Sacsayhuamán, Tiwanaku and others rest on material found near them, on texts, or on style. Pre-registered as H7; confirmed after an independent review.
points.link_text: The ten monuments where a first direct date would matter most

points.head: The Great Sphinx enclosure has never been dated directly.
points.text: No chlorine-36, U-series or carbonate dating of its walls has been published. A paired chlorine-36 comparison against Khafre-era quarry faces could test whether the enclosure is older than the conventional date — or confirm it.

points.head: Monte Verde, the textbook vindication, was reopened in 2026.
points.text: A Science paper argues for a mid-Holocene age. The challenger's own radiocarbon dates match the older age, and the key occupation layer was destroyed decades ago — so settling it now depends on archived material.

points.head: Real anomalies are usually partly right.
points.text: Of ten celebrated vindications, only three held cleanly; five were partly right and two are still open. All seven refuted cases stayed refuted.

points.head: "It can't be that old" objections fail more often.
points.text: 25% of objections that proved wrong argued from the accepted model, vs 8% of those that held — the predicted direction, but weak so far (p = 0.18).

points.head: The first data scans.
points.text: Dismissed old radiocarbon dates in a 173,946-date global database do not line up by region (a null). A second scan for dates older than each region's accepted first arrival flagged ten unfamiliar early-Americas sites.

caveat: These are leads, not discoveries. Each rests on published sources checked by a separate skeptic agent, and each names the test that would settle it — to be run by credentialed specialists with permits.
